privacyPage.s1.p1: Duru Korean is a website for learning Korean. This page explains, in plain language, what information we collect when you use it, why we collect it, and what you can ask us to do with it.
privacyPage.s2.p1: If you create an account: your email address. Your password is handled entirely by our authentication provider — we never see it, store it, or have any way to read it.
privacyPage.s2.p2: If you sign in with Google: Google gives us your name, email address, and profile picture. We do not receive your Google password or access anything else in your Google account.
privacyPage.s2.p3: Stored in your own browser: your chosen language, and a token that keeps you signed in. Both stay on your device and are cleared when you log out or clear your browser data.
privacyPage.s3.p1: We do not run advertising, analytics, or tracking scripts of any kind. We do not build profiles of you, and we do not sell, rent, or trade your information to anyone.
privacyPage.s4.p1: Accounts and any resources you download are handled by Supabase, a hosted database and authentication service, on servers operated by Supabase and its infrastructure providers. Files we publish for learners are stored there as well.
privacyPage.s5.p1: We keep your account information for as long as your account exists. If you ask us to delete your account, we remove your account record and the email address attached to it.
privacyPage.s6.p1: You can ask us at any time for a copy of what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete your account entirely. Email us and we will act on it.
privacyPage.s6.p2: You can also stop using the site at any time without giving a reason.
privacyPage.s7.p1: Duru Korean is intended for general audiences. If you believe a child has given us personal information without a guardian's involvement, contact us and we will remove it.
privacyPage.s8.p1: If we change how we handle information, we will update this page and change the date at the top. Substantial changes will be announced on the site.
privacyPage.s9.p1: Questions about anything on this page: hello@durukorean.com.
privacyPage.tagline: What we collect, why, and what you can ask us to do with it.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy — Duru Korean

startHere.cta.h2: Your Korean journey starts with one letter.
startHere.cta.p: Begin with Hangul Foundations today — it's free, and it takes less time than you think.
startHere.faq1.a: No — Step 1 teaches you Hangul from scratch. Most learners can read basic Korean within a week of focused practice.
startHere.faq1.q: Do I need to know Hangul before I start?
startHere.faq2.a: 15–20 minutes a day is enough to make steady progress. Consistency matters far more than long, infrequent sessions.
startHere.faq2.q: How much time should I spend studying each week?
startHere.faq3.a: Not at first — our free resources and online lessons cover the essentials. The Book & Audio edition is there when you want a structured, offline companion with full native audio.
startHere.faq3.q: Do I need the book to follow the lessons?
startHere.faq4.a: Duru Korean is designed primarily for teens and adult learners studying independently.
startHere.faq4.q: Is Duru Korean suitable for kids?

termsPage.s1.p1: By using Duru Korean you agree to what is written here. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. We have tried to keep this short and readable rather than long and defensive.
termsPage.s2.p1: Use a real email address you control, and keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account. Tell us promptly if you think someone else has got into it.
termsPage.s3.p1: Use Duru Korean for learning and teaching Korean. Please do not attempt to break into other people's accounts, disrupt the service for others, scrape the site wholesale, or upload anything unlawful.
termsPage.s4.p1: The lessons, audio, images, and downloadable materials on this site belong to Duru Korean and its authors. You may use them for your own learning, and teachers may use them with their own students.
termsPage.s4.p2: Please do not republish, resell, or redistribute them as your own work, or strip our name from them.
termsPage.s5.p1: Free materials are offered as they are. We work to keep them accurate and useful, but we cannot promise they are error-free or right for every learner's situation.
termsPage.s6.p1: We aim to keep the site running and up to date, but we cannot guarantee it will always be available or uninterrupted. Features may change as the site grows.
termsPage.s7.p1: You can stop using Duru Korean and ask us to delete your account at any time. We may close an account that is being used to harm other learners or the service itself.
termsPage.s8.p1: If these terms change, we will update this page and the date at the top. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the updated terms.
termsPage.tagline: The short version of what you and we agree to.
termsPage.title: Terms of Service — Duru Korean
